items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] [Humms] — that’s the way they did it.

ctx.x: [Humms] — that’s the way they did it. [Humms] But right toward the end there, there was something different on the original. I can’t remember what it was, but it wasn’t played too much after it became a pop song.
You did some pretty extensive studio work over the years. Was that mostly in New York?
